desc: Every day is a mission, and the Siege 25L Pack is your ultimate ally. Designed for those who demand more from their gear, this pack isn't just an accessory-it's a Mission Capable Pack for Everyday. Crafted with a lightweight yet robust 330D exterior, it's water-resistant and ready to tackle your daily grind. With more than 25L of capacity plus an expandable front stretch pocket, it's time to conquer your next challenge head-on: Siege your Mission, Siege your Day, Siege your Life!
